name: Daredevil

moves.name: Billy Club Strike
moves.description: Fast baton strike to a joint or temple.

moves.name: Combination
moves.description: Boxer's flurry of jabs, hooks, and an elbow, too fast to follow.

moves.name: Billy Club Throw
moves.description: Thrown baton that ricochets off a wall to strike from a blind angle.

moves.name: Grapnel Pull
moves.description: Cable wraps a wrist or ankle to disarm or trip; unavailable if the cable is cut.

moves.name: Cable Swing
moves.description: Swings in on the cable to close distance or out to escape; unavailable if the cable is cut.

moves.name: Rooftop Drop
moves.description: Descending two-footed strike from height that ends most street fights.

moves.name: Takedown
moves.description: Joint lock or hip throw that puts a foe on the pavement.

moves.name: Radar Parry
moves.description: Reads the attack by sound and air and counters it; fails under sensory overload.

moves.name: Heartbeat Read
moves.description: Locates hidden foes and flags lies or feints by heartbeat; fails against trained liars and machines.

moves.name: Pressure Point
moves.description: Precise strike that numbs a limb for a round.

moves.name: Shield Civilian
moves.description: Spends the round pulling a bystander behind cover.

leitmotif: Sparse, low, church-organ-style pad with a lone staccato pulse like a heartbeat; swells into a driving minor riff in combat.
